# YieldNest.online

> Independent Mutual Fund Research & Analytics Platform for Indian Equity & Debt Schemes.

YieldNest.online provides independent, quantitative, data-driven research on Indian Mutual Funds. Our articles analyze 3-year and 5-year rolling returns, downside capture ratios, standard deviation, portfolio overlap, expense ratio (TER) compounding drag, and AMFI India liquidity stress test disclosures.

We are strictly an investor education and quantitative research publication. Not registered with SEBI or AMFI; no financial advisory services, distributor commissions, or solicitation.

## Core Research Articles

- [Parag Parikh Flexi Cap vs Mirae Asset Large & Midcap: 5-Year Rolling Return Audit](https://yieldnest.online/article/parag-parikh-flexi-cap-vs-mirae-asset-large-midcap): Quantitative comparison of risk-adjusted alpha, downside capture (62% vs 88%), foreign equity allocation, and 5-year rolling returns against Nifty 500 TRI.
- [Small Cap Mutual Funds Stress Test: Liquidity Risk, Days-to-Liquidate & Market Resilience](https://yieldnest.online/article/small-cap-mutual-funds-stress-test-sebi-amfi-liquidity): In-depth examination of SEBI & AMFI stress tests for Nippon India, Quant, and HDFC Small Cap Funds, analyzing 25% and 50% liquidation horizons.
- [NIFTY 50 Index Funds vs Active Large-Cap Funds: Is Alpha Dead in Indian Equities?](https://yieldnest.online/article/nifty-50-index-funds-vs-active-large-cap-funds): SPIVA India scorecard audit examining how 85%+ of active large-cap managers fail to beat Nifty 50 TRI post-expenses.
- [Direct vs Regular Mutual Funds: The Compounding Drag of Distributor Commissions & Total Expense Ratios](https://yieldnest.online/article/direct-vs-regular-mutual-funds-charges-commissions-compounding): Mathematical breakdown of how 0.85% TER differential drains ₹47+ Lakhs on a 20-year monthly SIP of ₹25,000.
- [How to Measure Mutual Fund Performance: Rolling Returns, Alpha, Beta & Risk-Adjusted Ratios](https://yieldnest.online/article/evaluating-mutual-fund-performance-rolling-returns-risk-ratios): Comprehensive quantitative guide explaining rolling returns over trailing CAGR, Sortino Ratio, Sharpe Ratio, and Downside Capture.
- [AMFI & Regulatory Guidelines: Categorization Norms, Liquidity Mandates & Riskometer Framework](https://yieldnest.online/article/amfi-latest-regulatory-updates-categorization-norms-transparency): Definitive breakdown of SEBI categorization rules, dynamic riskometer metrics, and investor protection mandates.
- [Why TER Matters: Impact of Expense Ratio on Mutual Fund Returns](https://yieldnest.online/article/why-total-expense-ratio-ter-is-important-for-investors): Mathematical breakdown of how Total Expense Ratio (TER) drains wealth over a 20-year horizon, with SEBI regulatory slabs and Direct vs Regular plan fee analyses.
- [Quant Small Cap vs Nippon India Small Cap: A Data-Driven Analysis](https://yieldnest.online/article/quant-small-cap-vs-nippon-india-small-cap-comparison): Rigorous comparison of factor momentum rotation (VLRT model) vs institutional bottom-up diversification, liquidity stress test horizons, and 5-year rolling returns.

## Research Categories

- [Fund Comparison](https://yieldnest.online/category/fund-comparison): Side-by-side quantitative audits of peer mutual fund schemes.
- [Performance Analysis](https://yieldnest.online/category/performance-analysis): Rolling return analysis, factor exposures, and risk-adjusted metrics.
- [Market Trends](https://yieldnest.online/category/market-trends): AMFI inflows, SIP book trajectories, and macro liquidity trends.
- [Category Deep-Dive](https://yieldnest.online/category/category-deep-dive): Audits of Flexi Cap, Small Cap, Large & Mid Cap, and Index fund universes.
- [SIP Strategies](https://yieldnest.online/category/sip-strategies): Systematic investment planning tactics, step-up SIP compounding, and direct plan optimization.
